notes.title: Small Update and a New Language Available
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

A small update to Putt-Putt: Pep's Birthday Surprise is available now:

[list]
[*]DirectX 9.0c is now downloaded and installed on first running the game.
[/list]

In addition to this small change, I'm please to announce that the Dutch (Nederlands) version of the game is now available to all customers. Simply right-click the game in your Steam Library and click Properties. Go to the Language Tab and select your desired language from the Dropdown list.

Enjoy the game!

Saleck
Night Dive Studios
